name: Raytube
author: nathank
description: Cast menu for the Omarchy bar: cast the laptop screen or a separate TV desktop to an Apple TV (AirPlay) or a Chromecast. Needs the raytube tools (raytube-cast, raytube-tv) on PATH.

barWidget.description: Pick a TV and cast to it: the screen or the TV desktop, sound sync, picture size, and TV desktop scenes, layouts and rotation.
